description: This PHP class file defines the 'ParserSearchFields' class which extends 'ModuleBuilderParser'. It handles the reading, modification, and saving of search field metadata for modules in the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM framework, optionally within packages. The class provides methods for adding, removing, retrieving, and persisting search fields, including file inclusion logic for different module/package paths.

classes.name: ParserSearchFields
classes.description: Represents a parser for managing search field configurations for modules, extending 'ModuleBuilderParser'.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the parser with a module name and optional package name; loads search fields.

methods.name: addSearchField
methods.description: Adds a search field entry to the internal searchFields array for the specified module or package.

methods.name: removeSearchField
methods.description: Removes a search field entry from the internal searchFields array for the specified module or package.

methods.name: getSearchFields
methods.description: Loads search fields metadata from the appropriate file based on module/package context.

methods.name: saveSearchFields
methods.description: Persists the current search fields array into the appropriate metadata file.
